text:
Best line: smooth bump shapes refined by annealing, at high resolution with FFT scoring. Best program p0013 (0.835095), built from p0004 (0.832672) by upsampling to N=3000 and replacing np.convolve with scipy.signal.fftconvolve, with perturbation sizes rescaled to fractions of N and coordinate sweeps every 500 iterations. p0004 itself came from p0001 by replacing the constant start with cos^p bumps plus simulated annealing (multiplicative, block, noise perturbations). The target is a broad flat top of f*f: p0013 has ~39% of knots within 5% of the max, though its peak sits at 0.818 of the support.

What worked: p0007 (0.824845) three-block staircase from two-level init, showing multi-level structure helps but coarse levels are not enough. p0009 (0.831674) multi-resolution coordinate descent plus perturbations around p0007. p0012 (0.827498) K=10 contiguous-block coordinate descent on N=600, seeded from quantized p0007 — sharp piecewise structure is competitive but did not beat smooth bumps. p0011 (0.832952) central notch/two-bump search gave only +0.000281, so a central deficit barely helps. p0008 (0.805797) improved coordinate-wise hill climbing with midpoint resampling and tuned steps. p0005 (0.796296) grid-searched two-level step. p0003 (0.796973) multi-resolution bumps plus coordinate ascent. p0002 (0.763518) random hill climbing over structured bumps.

What failed: p0006 (0.790629) coordinate-wise multiplicative hill climbing on the two-level init underperformed its own start, likely because per-coordinate moves break the flat-top structure. p0010 (0.796973) analytic gradient ascent gave zero gain over p0003, so gradients are not the bottleneck. p0011's notch search essentially collapsed to no change. Coarse three-level search (p0007) plateaus well below smooth high-resolution shapes.

Open questions: whether even finer resolution than N=3000 or a better annealer schedule can push past 0.835; why p0013's convolution peak is off-centre at 0.818 and whether re-centring or asymmetric shaping helps; whether sharp many-block structure can be combined with smooth refinement rather than competing with it; and whether the flat-top objective has a ceiling near 0.84.
